proposals: MoSPI should publish a single revision-history table giving every estimate of each year's real GDP growth, from First Advance to the latest revision, with release dates, so users can see how far the first figure moved — by as much as 2 percentage points in recent years — without assembling it themselves.

MoSPI should add the missing early-stage estimates for FY2012–13 and FY2013–14 to its NAS data on api.mospi.gov.in, or state in the metadata that they do not exist, so a gap in the series is not mistaken for a year with no revision.

MoSPI should restore the NAS indicator-list endpoint on its data API and publish a status and changelog page for API faults and fixes, so users of the official machine-readable series know when an endpoint is broken and when it is repaired.

MoSPI should print, beside each new First Advance Estimate, the average and largest absolute revision seen at that stage over the previous ten years, so a headline growth figure is read together with how much such figures have typically changed.
